name: cognisphere
description: Agent harness plus a per-project vault: guards (master, secrets, memory drift), a Stop hook that asks for the vault's session log, .agents scaffold, /cognisphere:harness and /cognisphere:vault for either half alone, /cognisphere:read for vault notes copied in Obsidian, memory and rules mapping, explorer, planner, implementer, test-runner and reviewer agents, and an Obsidian-ready Agent/ workspace outside the repo.
